notes.title: Update
notes.content: Added a function to set the data start date, now allowing the selection of the start date. If a random start date is desired, it can be disabled on the game's confirmation screen upon entering

notes.title: FIX
notes.content:
1.Fix the abnormal asset score during settlement.

2.Optimize simulated trading and amplify the trading volume of simulated trading.

3.Change the color of the sell marker from red to orange.

4.Fix the bug that retains the conditional orders of the previous game when starting a new game.

5.Modify the position button on the trading interface from a percentage of available funds to a percentage of assets.

notes.title: Optimization
notes.content:
1.The player's initial lifespan is adjusted from 300 days to 3000 days

2.The real data training script normalizes the ETF value. Initially, all ETF prices are 100. This change is intended to facilitate knowing how much the price has risen or fallen.

3.When the player's lifespan is less than 10 days, a game pause will be triggered to avoid not knowing the income at the end of the game.

4.The numerical display on the trading interface is adjusted from the left side of the chart to the right side, and colors are added to it.

5.Fixed the problem of incorrect income display.

6.Now the time-price chart can display the transaction content of the day.

7.The number of transactions displayed on the daily chart has been increased to 100.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Optimize the initial data of the real data training script. Now the initial data of the daily line has increased from 50 to 150. And the data is real.

The initial amount of money for players has been increased to 1,000,000.

notes.title: Real Training Script Launched
notes.content:
[b]Real Training Script Launched[/b]

This script offers 10 times the regular points. The script will randomly select a starting point between 2011 and 2020. Historical data will be scaled to become ETF prices, so players cannot determine the exact historical position of the index based on ETF prices. This script provides all the index ETFs available in this game, so there's no need to specifically choose real data to use.

[b]Optimization[/b] 
Optimized candlesticks to make the starting and ending points more reasonable, ensuring that upper and lower shadows are not excessively long.

[b]UI Changes[/b] 
Added script introductions to the game entry confirmation interface.
 The position of my phone UI has been changed from the right to the left.

notes.title: Fixed
notes.content:
Fixed the issue that the industry interface did not display English. Fixed the issue that some Chinese characters could not be displayed.

Reworked the company details interface (access is by clicking on the company name in the upper left corner of the trading interface). Added an events page to the company details interface. Reworked the news page of the company details interface.

Now let's talk about how your stock trading went this month. I had a premonition before the Nasdaq crash, so I liquidated my positions in advance. But my greedy nature led me to increase my position by 15% at the peak, and the next day's plunge taught me a lesson. When the Nasdaq fell by 10%, I entered the market again to buy at the bottom (25% position), but suffered another sharp decline the next day. Nasdaq adjustments are common, but why did I feel that this time was different? Because the rise was too fast, exceeding the growth rate of fundamentals, and coupled with the arrival of an important time node, the bubble was likely to burst at this time. However, I won't wait for the bubble to burst completely before entering the market, because I don't know when the bottom will be. I started to gradually increase my positions according to my plan. I made a lot of mistakes this time, but fortunately, I always maintained a safe position and did not suffer fatal damage.

Reduced the frequency of simulated trading.
Temporarily closed the function of fast trading. Now players can experience the process of inputting the price and waiting for the deal to be completed more completely.

notes.title: Urgent update
notes.content:
I have added impulse trading to single-day trading, simulating the power to influence market trends. Now, the single-day trends are more difficult to predict and wilder. Additionally, I have updated the mail feature, removing the original function and adding a feature to preview clearing stocks.

I must admit that this part is a semi-finished product, because my original plan was to complete this part first, then modify the single-day trading. However, today many players have provided feedback that single-day trading is disappointing, so I prioritized resolving the single-day trading issue. As a result, the original function of the mail feature has been removed and only a semi-finished product has been released. Nonetheless, it is only one step away from completion and will be finished soon.

Since the new feature is relatively urgent, please let me know if there are any problems.

notes.title: Online Plan and Recent Work Progress
notes.content:
The past few weeks have been tough for me because my dog fell ill, and I needed to take care of him.

The game is scheduled to launch on June 7th. Currently, the focus is on optimizing performance, fixing bugs, and developing auxiliary features.

Here is the recent work completed:

Single-session saving. If a game session becomes too long and you wish to interrupt the game, you can exit the game, and the current session will be saved. The next time you log in, the previous session will automatically load. The game's saving and loading follow a "read and burn" mode. Once loaded, the save file will be deleted, and exiting the game will overwrite the save file. This is to prevent altering the future through save/load manipulation.

Added guidance. This includes an overview of the game and beginner tutorials.
